Spanish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /tɾankeˈaɾ/ [t̪ɾãŋ.keˈaɾ]
  • Rhymes: -aɾ
  • Syllabification: tran‧que‧ar

Verb

[edit]

tranquear (first-person singular present tranqueo, first-person singular preterite tranqueé, past participle tranqueado)

  1. (intransitive) alternative spelling of trancar
